sloka: तद्वानरबलं दृष्ट्वा रावणिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः।कृत्वा विकोशं निस्त्रिंशं मूर्ध्नि सीतां परामृशत् ।। ६.८१.१५ ।।
transliteration: tadvānarabalaṁ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇiḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ।kṛtvā vikośaṁ nistriṁśaṁ mūrdhni sītāṁ parāmṛśat ।। 6.81.15 ।।

translations.english: As they were looking at Sita on the chariot trickishly constructed, and she was crying saying, 'O Rama, O Rama', he stood and hit her.
